blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.
blocks.zh: 从有限的观测中产生新的观点,需要同时保留一个场景的外观和空间结构. 虽然最近的方法利用了精细的几何提示,但没有明确地模拟高级语义和空间特性,如物体身份、属性和物体间关系。 在这部作品中,我们调查3D语言理解能否为小说视角生成提供互补监督. 我们引入了Ask4NV,它基于一种经过预先训练的统一多式联运模式,并带有一种转换器的混合结构。 我们的模型将相机几何学结合到VAE和ViT的表示中,并通过共同的自觉和模式感知的注意力遮掩策略,在生成过程中利用对特征的理解. 实验在小说-视觉生成中展现出强烈的图像质量和几何一致性,同时具有竞争性的3D语言理解. 进一步的分析表明,联合培训改善了VAE表述中的交叉视图通信,以及3D-意识特征空间中的相似性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Novel-view generation ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Kwon et al., 2025 ) uses generative priors learned from large-scale data to synthesize images of a scene from unseen viewpoints given limited observations, while preserving scene appearance and geometric consistency.
Recent approaches incorporate geometric information through depth-based warping, cross-view correspondence or explicit geometry supervision ( Seo et al., 2024 ; Kwon et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) , providing fine-grained cues for cross-view consistency.
These advances support a wide range of applications, including video editing ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , robot manipulation ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and vision-language driving ( Wang et al., 2025c ) .
blocks.zh:
小说视图生成 (Gao等人,2024年;Lu等人,2025年;Kwon等人,2025年)利用从大规模数据中汲取的基因学前科,在有限观察下从看不见的视线合成场景的图像,同时保持场景外观和几何一致性.
近期的方法通过深度拓扑、交叉视野通信或明确的几何监督,纳入了几何信息(Seo等人,2024年;Kwon等人,2025年;Lu等人,2025年),为交叉视野的一致性提供了精细的提示。
这些进步支持了广泛的应用,包括视频编辑(张等人,2025年),机器人操纵(金等人,2025年),以及视觉语言驱动(王等人,2025年c).

blocks.en:
While such fine-grained geometric cues reveal the scene structure and dense correspondences across viewpoints, they do not explicitly offer the interpretation of high-level scene properties, such as object identities, attributes, and inter-object relationships.
Such high-level understanding can also guide novel-view generation by informing how objects and their spatial arrangements should appear from a different viewpoint.
For example, recognizing a red chair beside a wooden table can guide the model to preserve the chair’s identity, attributes, and relationship to the table, even as its visible shape and image position change with the viewpoint.
Learning these semantic and spatial properties could therefore complement fine-grained geometric information, helping the model preserve scene content and represent its spatial organization consistently across views.
blocks.zh:
虽然这种精细的几何提示揭示了场景结构以及不同角度的密集的对应关系,但它们没有明确提供高级场景属性的解释,如物体身份,属性,以及物体间关系.
这种高层次的理解还可以通过告知物体及其空间安排应如何从不同的角度出现来指导新观点的产生。
例如,在木桌旁认出一个红色的椅子可以指导模型保存椅子的身份、属性和与桌子的关系,即使其明显形状和图像位置随观点而变化。
因此,学习这些语义和空间特性可以补充精细的几何信息,帮助模型保存场景内容,并始终如一地代表其各种观点的空间组织.

blocks.en:
However, the potential of explicitly learning such high-level properties for novel-view generation remains largely unexplored.
We then ask: How can we provide such high-level semantic and spatial supervision, and how can it be incorporated into joint learning with novel-view generation? We investigate this direction through 3D language understanding tasks ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) , which involve identifying and localizing objects and reasoning about their attributes and spatial relationships.
Fig. 2 highlights the shared semantic and spatial properties underlying 3D language understanding and novel-view generation, suggesting the potential of language-based supervision to support generation.
To jointly learn novel-view generation and 3D language understanding, we adopt pretrained unified multimodal models ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Team, 2024 ) , which support both visual generation and multimodal understanding within a single model.
blocks.zh:
然而,为新颖视野的一代明确学习这种高级特性的潜力基本上仍未加以探讨。
然后,我们问:我们如何提供这种高层次的语义和空间监督,如何将其纳入与新颖观点一代的联合学习? 我们通过3D语言理解任务(Hong et al., 2023;Huang et al., 2023;Zheng et al., 2025b)来调查这一方向,这些任务涉及确定和定位物体及其属性和空间关系的推理.
图2突出了三维语言理解和新颖视角生成背后的共同语义和空间属性,提出了基于语言的监督支持生成的潜力.
为了共同学习小说-视觉生成和3D语言理解,我们采用了经过预先培训的统一多式联运模式(Xie等人,2025年;Team,2024年),这些模式支持一个单一模式内的视觉生成和多式联运理解。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Shared scene properties across 3D language understanding and novel-view generation. Questions about object categories, attributes, and spatial relationships address the same scene properties that should be represented in novel views. The knowledge required to answer these questions can provide complementary semantic and spatial supervision for novel-view generation.
blocks.zh: 图 2:共享场景属性,跨越3D语言理解和小说视角生成. 关于物体类别、属性和空间关系的问题涉及在新观点中应体现的相同场景属性。 回答这些问题所需的知识可以为新颖视角生成提供互补的语义和空间监督.

blocks.en:
Concretely, we introduce Ask4NV , which builds on a pretrained Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture ( Liang et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) and introduces a small set of architectural modifications to jointly model 3D language understanding and novel-view generation.
The MoT architecture provides task-specific parameters together with joint self-attention between the two transformers, allowing the two tasks to be learned within a shared framework without introducing a separate cross-task fusion module.
For novel-view generation, we use VAE latents alongside complementary ViT features from the understanding transformer and incorporate camera geometry into both representations through Plücker ray embeddings.
We further design an attention masking strategy to facilitate information exchange across different token modalities during novel-view generation.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,我们引入了Ask4NV,它以经过预先训练的变形体混合结构(Liang et al., 2024; Deng et al., 2025)为基础,并引入了一套小型的建筑修改,以联合模式3D语言理解和小说视角生成.
MOT架构提供任务特定参数,同时两个变压器之间的联合自留心,使得两个任务能够在一个共享框架内学习,而无需引入单独的跨任务聚变模块.
对于小说视角的生成,我们使用VAE潜伏物与来自理解变压器的互补ViT特征并用,并通过普吕克射线嵌入法将相机几何学结合到两个表示物中.
我们进一步设计了一项遮盖注意力的战略,以促进在新颖视角生成过程中不同象征性方式之间的信息交流。

blocks.en:
Our analyses examine how joint training with 3D language understanding affects the model’s visual representations and novel-view generation capabilities.
Extensive experiments show that our model achieves strong novel-view generation performance in both image quality and geometric consistency across multiple evaluation settings.
It also performs competitively on 3D language understanding despite the limited performance of its pretrained backbone on these tasks.
Ablation studies further validate our architectural and attention design choices.
blocks.zh:
我们的分析研究了与3D语言理解联合培训如何影响模型的视觉表现和新颖视觉生成能力。
广泛的实验表明,我们的模型在图像质量和多个评价环境的几何一致性方面都取得了强大的新颖视角生成性能.
尽管它在这些任务方面经过预先培训的骨干部门的业绩有限,但是它还是在3D语言理解上进行竞争性的发挥.
沉思研究进一步验证了我们的建筑和注意力设计选择.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We introduce Ask4NV , which strengthens semantic and spatial understanding for novel-view generation through supervision from 3D language understanding tasks.
Our model builds on Lance-Video-3B ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , a pretrained unified multimodal model with specialized generation and understanding transformers.
The generation transformer incorporates camera geometry into its visual inputs and enables bidirectional attention between clean source and noisy target VAE tokens (Sec. 3.1 ).
Representations from the understanding transformer are incorporated into novel-view generation through ViT conditioning and an attention mask that controls interactions among visual tokens (Sec. 3.2 ).
Then, we train the model with a flow-matching objective, supplemented by 3D language understanding objectives as auxiliary supervision (Sec. 3.3 ).
We further analyze cross-view correspondence of VAE tokens and assess semantic and spatial knowledge of our model (Sec. 4 ).
The overall architecture is shown in Fig. 3 .

blocks.en: 3.1 Camera-Conditioned Novel-View Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 相机配置小说-视频生成

blocks.en:
We incorporate visual representations processed by the understanding transformer into novel-view generation, allowing generation to explicitly utilize semantic and spatial information.
Specifically, we extract ViT features from all source views and include them alongside the VAE tokens.
The understanding transformer processes these ViT tokens, and the generation transformer accesses their representations through joint self-attention.

具体地说,我们从所有源视图中提取ViT特性,并把它们与VAE符一起包含.
理解变压器处理这些ViT符号,生成变压器通过联合自觉访问它们的表示.

blocks.en:

We preserve the pretrained ViT projector’s joint spatial merging and channel projection by adding ray embeddings to its output.

We concatenate the camera-aware source VAE and ViT tokens, noisy target VAE tokens, and text tokens into an input sequence.
The two Transformers process their respective tokens through joint self-attention, with an attention mask controlling information flow among token groups.
Noisy target tokens can attend to both source VAE and ViT tokens, accessing source appearance and representations from the understanding transformer.
Source ViT tokens attend bidirectionally to clean VAE tokens but do not directly attend to noisy target tokens.
The complete attention pattern, including the bidirectional VAE attention described in Sec. 3.1 , is illustrated in Fig. 3 (c).

The resulting target hidden states are projected to velocity predictions, and the model is trained with the flow-matching objective.
At inference, we initialize the target latents with Gaussian noise, integrate the predicted velocity field, and decode the resulting latents into target images using the VAE decoder.

blocks.en: 4 Analyzing the Effects of Joint Training
blocks.zh: 4 分析联合培训的影响

blocks.en:
In this section, we analyze how joint training with 3D language understanding benefits novel-view generation.
We compare Ask4NV with two baselines initialized from the same pretrained Lance checkpoint ( Fu et al., 2026 ) .
Lance-FT is fine-tuned exclusively on novel-view generation, while Lance-FT + ViT uses the same ViT conditioning pathway and generation-side attention mask as Ask4NV, but is trained without 3D language understanding samples or objectives.
Both baselines are only trained on novel-view generation training samples.
blocks.zh:
在这一节中,我们分析与3D语言理解的联合培训如何有利于新颖-视觉生成.
我们比较了Ask4NV与从同一预先训练的兰斯检查站(Fu等人,2026年)初始化的两个基线.
Lance-FT完全在小说视角生成上进行微调,而Lance-FT + VIT则使用与Ask4NV相同的ViT调节路径和生成侧关注罩,但训练时没有3D语言理解样本或目标.
这两个基线只接受新颖视角生成培训样本的培训。

blocks.en: Finding 1. 3D language supervision improves cross-view correspondence beyond ViT conditioning.
blocks.zh: 查找 1.3D语言监督改进了超越ViT条件的交叉视图通信.

blocks.en: Table 1: Cross-view Correspondence at Layer 26. We report PCK@1, PCK@2, and PCK@4 on ScanNet and ScanNet++ for Lance-FT, Lance-FT + ViT and Ask4NV.
blocks.zh: 表1:第26层的交叉视图信函。 我们在ScanNet和ScanNet++上报告PCK@1,PCK@2和PCK@4,用于Lance-FT,Lance-FT+ViT和Ask4NV.

blocks.en:
We examine whether adding 3D language understanding supervision improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations, without explicitly supervising correspondence during training.
We evaluate correspondence in a two-view setting using clean VAE tokens from both views, focusing on corresponding tokens associated with the same 3D points across overlapping views.
Since correspondence quality varies across transformer layers, we first evaluate each layer independently.
Specifically, we extract the intermediate token feature after the attention computation and, for each object token in one view, identify its correspondence in the other view by selecting the token with the highest cosine similarity.
We evaluate the predicted correspondences using PCK@1, PCK@2, and PCK@4, where a prediction is considered correct if it lies within 1, 2, or 4 token-grid locations of the ground-truth correspondence.
As shown in Fig. 4 , Layer l = 26 l=26 achieves the strongest correspondence across the evaluated thresholds, and we therefore use its representations for the analysis.
Prior work such as VIRAL ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) highlights the importance of intermediate visual representations for fine-grained visual understanding.
blocks.zh:
我们审查增加3D语言理解监督是否改善VAE陈述中的交叉视图通信,而不明确监督培训期间的通信。
我们使用两种观点中干净的VAE符号,在双视图环境中评价函证,重点是在重叠观点中与同一立体点相关联的相应符证.
由于各变压器层的对应质量不同,我们首先独立评价每层.
具体地说,我们在注意度计算后提取中间符号特性,对于一个视图中的每个对象符号,通过选择具有最高余弦相似性的符号,在另一个视图中识别其对应.
我们使用PCK@1、PCK@2和PCK@4来评估预测的通信,如果预测位于地面-真实通信的1、2或4个信号网位置,则认为预测是正确的。
如图4所示,Lyetle l = 26 l = 26 实现了超过评价阈值的最强对应,因此我们用其表示法进行分析.
先前的作品如VIRAL(Yoon等人,2025年)强调了中间视觉表现对精细视觉理解的重要性.

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that Ask4NV consistently outperforms both baselines across both datasets and all PCK thresholds.
Notably, although the additional understanding objectives supervise the understanding Transformer, correspondence improves in the generation Transformer’s intermediate VAE representations without direct correspondence supervision.
This provides encouraging evidence that the benefits of 3D language understanding extend to spatial representations used for generation.
blocks.zh:
表1显示,Ask4NV在数据集和所有PCK阈值的基线方面都一贯超过业绩。
值得注意的是,虽然额外的理解目标监督理解变形器,但是在一代变形器的中间VAE表述中,没有直接的函证监督的函证改善.
这提供了令人鼓舞的证据,表明3D语言理解的好处扩展到用于生成的空间表示.

blocks.en: Finding 2. Joint training improves similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.
blocks.zh: 查找 2. 联合培训提高了3D-意识特征空间的相似性。

blocks.en: Table 2: Patch-wise feature similarity between generated and ground-truth views. We report feature similarity on DL3DV, ScanNet, RealEstate10K (Re10K), and ScanNet++.
blocks.zh: 表2:生成的和地面真实视图的补丁特性相似。 我们报告在DL3DV、ScanNet、RealEstate10K(Re10K)和ScanNet++上有相似之处。

blocks.en:
We analyze whether joint training improves the similarity between generated and ground-truth views in a 3D-aware representation space.
To this end, we use the SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) vision encoder fine-tuned for 3D language understanding within Video-3D-LLM ( Zheng et al., 2025b ) .
We extract generated and ground-truth features at the same target viewpoint and compute the mean cosine similarity between spatially corresponding patch features.
blocks.zh:
我们分析联合培训是否改善了3D-意识代表空间中生成的和地面真实观点的相似性。
为此,我们使用SigLIP(Zhai等人,2023年)视觉编码器在Video-3D-LLM(Zheng等人,2025年b)中微调3D语言理解.
我们在同一目标角度提取生成的和地面真实的特征,并计算空间对应的补丁特征之间的平均余弦相似性。

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows that Ask4NV achieves higher feature similarity than both generation-only baselines across all four datasets.
The improvement over Lance-FT + ViT indicates an additional benefit of joint training beyond ViT conditioning.
These results show that joint training produces generated views that are more closely aligned with the ground-truth views in the feature space of a 3D language understanding encoder.
blocks.zh:
表2显示,Ask4NV在所有四个数据集中实现的特性相似度高于两个仅生成的基线.
与Lance-FT + ViT相比的改进表明,除了ViT条件之外,联合培训还有额外的好处.
这些结果表明,联合培训所产生的观点与3D语言理解编码器的特征空间中的地面真实观点更为一致。

blocks.en:
Implementation and training details. We build our model on Lance-Video-3B ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , a pretrained MoT-based unified multimodal model, and fine-tune it while freezing the ViT encoder and the VAE encoder and decoder.
Our 3D language understanding training data comprise ScanNet-based datasets, including SQA3D ( Ma et al., 2022 ) , ScanQA ( Azuma et al., 2022 ) , ScanRefer ( Chen et al., 2020 ) , and Multi3DRefer ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) .
We therefore use ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) for novel-view generation to align the scene domains across the two tasks.
Given its limited number of scenes, we supplement the generation training data with DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) .
We use multimodal sequence packing, with each pack containing three novel-view generation samples and one 3D language understanding sample.
This 3 : 1 3:1 ratio approximates the pretraining task balance within our computational budget.
The understanding task uses V = 32 V=32 uniformly sampled frames per scene.
For novel-view generation, we sample 8 8 frames, using 2 2 – 4 4 as source views and the remainder as target views.
Additional implementation details are provided in Appendix A.3 .

blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol. To assess novel-view generation quality, we evaluate Ask4NV on DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) and ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) as in-domain datasets, and RealEstate10K (Re10K) ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) and ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) as out-of-domain datasets, relative to our training data.
In the main comparison, each model generates M = 4 M=4 target views from N = 4 N=4 source views.
We compare against diffusion-based novel view generation models, including CAT3D ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , Matrix3D ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , NVComposer ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and CAMEO ( Kwon et al., 2025 ) .
Omni-View ( Hu et al., 2026 ) is also included as a unified multimodal model baseline.
We report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS to measure 2D image fidelity, and camera estimation errors and MEt3R ( Asim et al., 2025 ) to assess 3D geometric consistency.
Further details on evaluation are provided in Appendix A.4 .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigate how joint training with 3D language understanding can enhance novel-view generation.
We introduce Ask4NV, which adapts a pretrained MoT-based architecture through ViT conditioning and a tailored attention mask.
Experiments demonstrate improvements in image fidelity and geometric consistency across multiple benchmarks, while maintaining competitive 3D language understanding performance.
Our analyses show improved cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and stronger alignment with ground-truth views in a 3D-aware feature space.
Ablation studies further validate the benefits of joint training and our architectural choices.
These findings highlight the potential of 3D language understanding as complementary supervision for generative scene modeling.

实验显示,图像忠贞度和多种基准的几何一致性有所改善,同时保持了竞争性的三维语言理解性能.
我们的分析表明,VAE表述中的交叉视图通信有所改善,在3D-意识特征空间中,与地面真实观点更加一致。
校对研究进一步验证了联合培训和我们建筑选择的好处。
这些研究结果突出了3D语言理解作为基因场景模型补充监督的潜力.

For novel-view generation, we use a timestep shift of 4.0 4.0 and apply conditioning dropout with a probability of 0.1 0.1 to each of the text and camera conditions.
For 3D visual grounding, we set the temperature hyperparameter τ grd = 0.07 \tau_{\mathrm{grd}}=0.07 .
Following our backbone, we set the loss weights λ gen \lambda_{\mathrm{gen}} and λ und \lambda_{\mathrm{und}} to 1.0 1.0 and 0.25 0.25 , respectively.
For a fair comparison, Lance-FT, Lance-FT + ViT, and Ask4NV are trained for the same number of optimizer steps and observe the same number of novel-view generation samples.

For camera-pose evaluation, we jointly estimate poses from the generated target views using a fixed VGGT- Ω \Omega -1B-512 checkpoint ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , without including source images or ground-truth target images.
We align the estimated camera centers to the corresponding ground-truth centers using a least-squares Sim(3) transformation computed with the Umeyama algorithm.

blocks.en: Appendix B Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录B 相关工作

blocks.en: B.1 Novel View Generation
blocks.zh: B.1 小说视图生成

blocks.en:
Novel-view synthesis (NVS) aims to predict the appearance of a scene from unseen viewpoints given observed views.
Reconstruction-based approaches, such as NeRF ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) and 3D Gaussian Splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) , model scenes using 3D representations from which novel views are rendered.
Recent advances in generative modeling ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) have enabled novel-view generation from sparse observations by leveraging learned visual priors.
To adapt these priors to 3D scenes, existing methods explore camera conditioning ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Sargent et al., 2024 ) , geometric guidance ( Cao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , cross-view consistency ( Kwon et al., 2025 ; Müller et al., 2024 ) , and geometry-aware latent representations ( Jang et al., 2026 ) .
While these approaches primarily focus on view synthesis, Omni-View ( Hu et al., 2026 ) jointly models novel-view synthesis, 3D language understanding, and geometric estimation, emphasizing how generation facilitates understanding.
Our work instead investigates how semantic and spatial supervision from 3D language understanding can improve novel-view generation.
We pursue this direction through joint training on overlapping scene domains and explicitly use the understanding expert’s visual representations during generation.
blocks.zh:
小说-视图合成(NVS)旨在预测从所观测到的看不见的观点中出现场景。
基于重建的方法,如NERF(Mildenhall等人,2021年)和3D Gaussian Splatting(Kerbl等人,2023年),使用3D表示的模型场景,从中得出新观点.
近期在基因模型学方面的进步(Ho等人,2020年;Rombach等人,2022年;Peebles和Xie,2023年),通过利用学到的视觉前科,使得小说视角从稀少的观察中产生.
为适应3D场景,现有方法探索相机配置(Gao等人,2024年;Sargent等人,2024年),几何指导(Cao等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年),交叉视角一致性(Kwon等人,2025年;Müller等人,2024年),以及几何潜在表达. (张等,2026).
虽然这些方法主要侧重于视图合成,但Omni-View(Hu et al., 2026)联合模拟了小说-视图合成,3D语言理解和几何估计,强调生成如何促进理解.
相反,我们的工作研究了从3D语言理解中进行语义学和空间监督如何能改善小说视角生成。
我们通过关于重叠场景域的联合培训来追求这一方向,并在一代人中明确使用理解专家的视觉表现。

blocks.en: B.2 3D Language Understanding
blocks.zh: B.2 3D 语言理解

blocks.en:
Understanding 3D scenes through natural language involves diverse tasks such as 3D question answering ( Azuma et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , 3D dense captioning ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024a ) , and 3D visual grounding ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) .
A line of open-vocabulary 3D understanding methods lifts semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models, particularly CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and LSeg ( Li et al., 2022 ) , into 3D representations such as point clouds ( Jatavallabhula et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , neural radiance fields ( Engelmann et al., 2024 ; Kerr et al., 2023 ) , and 3D Gaussians ( Jun-Seong et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) .
Building on recent developments in 2D Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Hurst et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , numerous efforts aim to extend multimodal understanding to 3D environments by introducing geometric knowledge into these models in various ways.
Some works incorporate spatial information through 3D positional embeddings ( Zheng et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) , voxelized scene features ( Fu et al., 2024a ) , or bird’s-eye-view representations ( Qi et al., 2026 ) , whereas others inject geometric priors through distillation ( Huang et al., 2026 ) or fusion ( Fan et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025a ) of 3D-aware features.
Ross3D ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and G 2 VLM ( Hu et al., 2025 ) take a different approach by combining 3D language understanding with reconstruction, exploiting their complementary signals to improve spatial understanding.
Imagine3D-LLM ( Jung et al., 2026 ) improves 3D language understanding by learning compact Gaussian scene representations through reconstruction supervision.
blocks.zh:
通过自然语言理解3D场景涉及多种任务,如3D问答(Azuma等人,2022年;Ma等人,2026年;Ma等人,2022年;Yang等人,2025年),3D密集字幕(Chen等人,2021年;Chen等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年a年),以及3D视觉地面(Chen等人,2020年;Zhang等人,2023年).
开放式的3D理解方法将2D基础模型,特别是CLIP(拉德福德等人,2021年)和LSeg(李等人,2022年)的语义知识提升到点云(Jatavallabhula等人,2023年;杨等人,2024年;周等人,2025年),神经辐射场(Engelmann等人,2024年;Kerr等人,2023年)和3D Gaussians(Jun-Seong等人,2025年;Qin等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年)等3D表示.
借鉴2D多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的近期发展 (Bai等人,2025年;Hurst等人,2024年;Liu等人,2023年),许多努力的目的是通过以各种方式在这些模型中引入几何知识,将多式联运理解扩大到三维环境。
一些作品通过三维定位嵌入法(郑等人,2025b;朱等人,2024),花纹化场景特征(傅等人,2024a),或鸟眼观的表示法,将空间信息纳入其中. (Qi等人,2026年),而其他人则通过蒸馏(Huang等人,2026年)或聚变(Fan等人,2026年;Zheng等人,2025年a)注入三维意识特征的几何前缀.
Ross3D(Wang等人,2025a)和G2 VLM(Hu等人,2025年)采取不同的做法,将3D语言理解与重建相结合,利用其互补信号来增强空间理解.
设想3D-LLM (Jung et al., 2026)通过重建监督学习紧凑的高斯大陆场景表现来提高3D语言理解.

blocks.en: B.3 Unified multimodal model
blocks.zh: B.3 统一多式联运模式

blocks.en:
Unified multimodal models integrate multimodal understanding and visual generation within a single framework.
Chameleon ( Team, 2024 ) and Emu3 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) unify these capabilities through autoregressive next-token prediction.
Janus ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) uses separate visual encoders for understanding and generation while retaining a unified Transformer backbone.
Other approaches combine next-token prediction with diffusion-based visual generation ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025 ) .
Bagel ( Deng et al., 2025 ) and Lance ( Fu et al., 2026 ) adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures with specialized Transformer experts interacting through joint self-attention.
Recent studies also investigate knowledge transfer between understanding and generation ( Kang et al., 2026 ) .
Building on this line of research, we focus on improving novel-view generation through semantic and spatial supervision from 3D language understanding.
blocks.zh:
统一的多式联运模式将多式联运理解和视觉生成结合在一个框架内。
Chameleon (Team, 2024)和Emu3 (Wang et al, 2024)通过自转的下位预测来统一这些能力.
Janus (Wu et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025b) 使用单独的视觉编码器来理解和生成,同时保留统一的变形器骨干.
其他方法将下位预测与基于扩散的视觉生成结合起来(Chen等人,2025a); 谢等, 2025).
Bagel (Deng et al., 2025)和Lance (Fu et al., 2026)采用由专门的变形器专家通过联合自觉互动的变形器(MoT)结构.
最近的研究还调查了理解与生成之间的知识转让(Kang等人,2026年)。
在这个研究线的基础上,我们侧重于通过从3D语言理解中进行语义和空间监督来改进小说-视觉生成.

blocks.zh: C.1 关于联合培训设计的规定。

blocks.en: Table 7: Ablation on joint training settings for novel-view generation. All Gen-ViT configurations use the same generation-side camera conditioning.
blocks.zh: 表7:新视觉一代联合培训环境的考虑。 所有Gen-ViT配置都采用相同的一代侧相机配置.

blocks.en: Table 8: Ablation on joint training settings for 3D language understanding.
blocks.zh: 表8:关于3D语言理解联合培训设置的说明。

blocks.en:
We examine how joint training and visual conditioning affect novel-view generation and 3D language understanding. Joint denotes training on both tasks.
Without joint training, the model is trained only on the task being evaluated. Gen-ViT denotes ViT conditioning for novel-view generation, while Und-VAE denotes additional VAE conditioning for 3D language understanding.
All configurations with Gen-ViT use the same generation-side ViT conditioning, Plücker-ray embeddings, and attention mask. Thus, the Joint ✗ and Gen-ViT ✓ setting corresponds to Lance-FT + ViT and differs from our final model only in the absence of 3D language understanding training.
We use the same datasets and evaluation protocols as in the main experiments.
Our model enables Joint and Gen-ViT without Und-VAE.
blocks.zh:
我们审查联合培训和视觉调节如何影响新颖-视觉生成和3D语言理解。 联合培训是指两项任务的培训。
没有联合培训,该模式只接受评价任务的培训。 Gen-ViT表示用于小说视图生成的ViT条件,而Und-VAE表示用于3D语言理解的额外VAE条件.
Gen-ViT的所有配置都使用同代侧ViT调制,Plücker-ray嵌入,以及注意力罩. 因此,Joint QQ和Gen-ViT的设置与Lance-FT + ViT相对应,只有在没有3D语言理解培训的情况下才与我们最终的模型不同.
我们使用与主要实验相同的数据集和评价协议.
我们的模型可以实现联合和Gen-ViT 没有Und-VAE.

blocks.en:
Novel-view generation. Table 7 shows that adding ViT conditioning improves PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS across all four datasets.
Joint training without Und-VAE further improves all three image fidelity metrics and most geometric consistency metrics compared with generation-only training with ViT conditioning.
However, additionally enabling Und-VAE reduces image fidelity on every dataset and worsens most geometric metrics, despite improvements in rotation RPE on ScanNet and ScanNet++ and translation RPE on ScanNet and ScanNet++.
Our configuration achieves the best image fidelity across all four datasets, supporting the use of joint training with ViT conditioning without additional VAE conditioning for understanding.
blocks.zh:
小说视觉一代. 表7显示,加入ViT调制可以改善所有四个数据集的PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS.
没有Und-VAE的联合培训,与使用ViTcult的仅一代培训相比,进一步改善了所有三个图像忠心度量和大多数几何一致性度量.
然而,尽管ScanNet和ScanNet++上的RPE旋转和ScanNet和ScanNet++上的RPE翻译有所改进,但进一步启用Ud-VAE会降低每个数据集的图像可靠性,并恶化大多数几何度量.
我们的配置在所有四个数据集中都实现了最佳的图像忠实,支持使用与ViTcapulation的联合训练而无需额外的VAE条件来理解.

blocks.en:
3D language understanding. Table 8 shows relatively small variations in understanding performance across the evaluated configurations.
Under joint training, additional VAE conditioning yields modest gains on SQA3D and visual grounding, while our configuration performs better on most ScanQA metrics.
Thus, Und-VAE provides no consistent benefit across understanding benchmarks.
Our configuration maintains broadly comparable understanding performance while achieving better novel-view generation quality.
blocks.zh:
3D语言理解. 表8显示,对所评价的组合在理解业绩方面的差异较小。
在联合训练下,额外的VAE调制在SQA3D和视觉地面上略有提高,而我们的配置在大多数ScanQA度量衡上表现较好.
因此,Und-VAE在理解基准方面没有提供一致的好处。
我们的配置保持了大致相当的理解性能,同时实现了更好的新颖视觉生成质量.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Cross-view correspondence accuracy throughout training.
blocks.zh: 图6:整个培训的交叉视图通信准确性。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Visualization of cross-view VAE feature similarity.
blocks.zh: 图7:交叉视图VAE的可视化特征相似.

blocks.en: C.2 Additional analysis on correspondence of VAE.
blocks.zh: C.2 对VAE通信的补充分析。

blocks.en:
We extend the analysis in Sec. 4 by examining how cross-view correspondence develops during training and visualizing the cosine similarity of VAE token representations across views.
We measure token-level correspondence using the attention-output features at layer l = 26 l=26 .
blocks.zh:
我们扩展了第4节的分析,研究了交叉视图通信在培训过程中如何发展,并可视化各种观点中的VAE符号表达的余弦相似性。
我们使用注意输出的特性,用L = 26 l = 26 来测量符号级的通信。

blocks.en:
Correspondence throughout training. Figure 6 compares Ask4NV with Lance-FT throughout training on ScanNet.
Across all three thresholds, Ask4NV reaches the final correspondence accuracy of Lance-FT substantially earlier and achieves higher accuracy throughout training after the initial stage.
These results suggest that our joint training design promotes the development of cross-view consistent VAE representations.
blocks.zh:
整个培训期间的通信。 图6将Ask4NV和Lance-FT在整个ScanNet培训期间进行比较。
在所有三个门槛上, Ask4NV大大提前达到Lance-FT的最终对应精度,并在初始阶段后在整个训练中达到更高的精度.
这些结果显示,我们的联合培训设计促进了跨观点一致性的VAE表述方式的发展.

blocks.en:
Cross-view feature similarity. We visualize cross-view feature similarity by computing cosine similarity between a query VAE token’s attention-output feature and those of all VAE tokens in another view, without camera conditioning.
The resulting similarity maps are overlaid on the corresponding images.
Figure 7 presents the examples of overlaid images of Lance-FT and Ask4NV.
Compared with the diffuse responses of the baseline, Ask4NV exhibits more localized feature responses around corresponding scene regions, illustrating its ability to capture cross-view correspondences more accurately.
blocks.zh:
交叉视图特征相似. 我们通过计算一个查询 VAE 符号的注意力输出特性和另一个视图中所有 VAE 符号的注意力输出特性之间的 余弦相似性, 将交叉视图特征进行可视化, 不进行相机配置 。
由此产生的相似性图被覆盖在相应的图像上.
图7显示了Lance-FT和Ask4NV的覆盖图像的例子。
与基线的分散反应相比,Ask4NV在相应场景区域周围显示更局部的特征反应,说明其更准确地捕捉交叉视图对应的能力.

blocks.en: Table 9: Ablation on bidirectional attention between visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 表9:视觉符号之间的双向注意力。

blocks.en: C.3 Ablation on bidirectional attention between visual tokens.
blocks.zh: C.3 视觉符号之间双向注意的偏差。

blocks.en:
Novel-view generation in Ask4NV involves three groups of visual tokens: source ViT tokens, clean source VAE tokens, and noisy target VAE tokens.
We extend the ablation in Table 6 by examining the effects of allowing bidirectional attention between different visual token groups. ViT–VAE bidir. denotes bidirectional attention between source ViT and clean source VAE tokens, while Noise–Clean bidir. denotes bidirectional attention between clean source and noisy target VAE tokens.
Our model enables both forms of bidirectional attention.
blocks.zh:
Ask4NV中的小说-视图生成涉及三组视觉符号:源ViT符号,清源VAE符号,以及吵闹的目标VAE符号.
我们通过审查不同视觉标志群体之间允许双向关注的效果来延长表6中的减缩。 ViT-VAE bidir. 表示来源ViT和干净来源VAE符之间的双向关注, 而Noise-Clean bidir. 表示干净源头和吵闹的目标VAE符号之间的双向关注.
我们的模式可以使这两种形式的双向关注。

blocks.en:
Enabling both forms of attention achieves the best results across all reported metrics on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, and most metrics on ScanNet++.
On ScanNet, enabling only Noise–Clean bidirectional attention yields better PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while our configuration achieves better ATE, translation RPE, and MEt3R.
Nevertheless, enabling both connections provides more consistent performance across datasets, including the out-of-domain RealEstate10K and ScanNet++ benchmarks, supporting our attention mask design.
blocks.zh:
在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上,以及ScanNet++上的大多数度量衡上,使这两种形式的关注都能取得最佳结果。
在ScanNet上,只允许噪声 - 清除双向注意产生更好的PSNR, SSIM,和LPIPS, 而我们的配置则实现更好的ATE, 翻译 RTE, 和 Met3R 。
尽管如此,两条连接都提供了更加一致的跨数据集性能,包括域外的RealEstate10K和ScanNet++基准,支持我们的注意力罩设计.

blocks.en: C.4 Effect of Understanding Supervision.
blocks.zh: C.4 理解监督的效果。

blocks.en: Table 10: Ablation on the composition of 3D language understanding supervision.
blocks.zh: 表10:关于3D语言理解监督的组成情况。

blocks.en:
We examine how the composition of 3D language understanding supervision affects novel-view generation by comparing question answering, visual grounding, and their combination.
All configurations use the same architecture and ViT conditioning and are evaluated at matched intermediate checkpoints with equal numbers of generation and understanding training samples.
blocks.zh:
我们研究3D语言理解监督的构成如何通过比较问答,视觉地基及其组合来影响新视觉生成.
所有配置都使用相同的架构和ViT调制,并在匹配的中间检查站进行评估,生成和理解培训样本的数量相同。

blocks.en:
Table 10 shows that QA-only supervision achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on both DL3DV and ScanNet, while grounding-only supervision performs comparably to the combined configuration.
These results suggest that allocating more of the understanding training budget to question answering benefits novel-view generation in this setting.
Our default configuration includes both tasks to support question answering and visual grounding.
blocks.zh:
表10显示,只限QA监管在DL3DV和ScanNet上都实现了最好的PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS,而只限地面监管则与组合配置具有可比性.
这些结果表明,在这种背景下,将更多的理解培训预算用于质疑答案的好处和新观点。
我们的默认配置既包括支持回答问题的任务,也包括视觉定位的任务.

blocks.en: C.5 Additional qualitative results.
blocks.zh: C.5 其他质量结果。

blocks.en: We provide additional qualitative results on DL3DV, ScanNet, Re10K, and ScanNet++ in Figs. 8 – 13 .
blocks.zh: 我们在图中提供了DL3DV、ScanNet、Re10K和ScanNet++的更多定性结果。

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Future work
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Our experiments demonstrate improvements in novel-view generation under the evaluated multi-view settings.
Extending these benefits to longer camera trajectories and more diverse in-the-wild scenes remains an important direction, requiring consistent preservation of scene appearance and geometry across broader viewing conditions.
Our current training and evaluation also use a fixed image resolution.
Supporting multiple resolutions and higher-resolution outputs would broaden the method’s applicability while introducing additional challenges in preserving fine visual details across views.
Larger models and more diverse training data would enable further investigation of how the benefits of 3D language supervision scale.
Although a performance gap remains relative to leading 3D language understanding models, future unified backbones with stronger understanding capabilities may help narrow this gap and provide richer supervision for novel-view generation.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验表明,在评估的多视图环境中,新视觉生成有所改进。
将这些好处扩大到更长的相机轨迹和更加多样化的全景仍然是一个重要的方向,需要在整个更广阔的取景条件下始终如一地保存场景外观和几何特征.
我们目前的训练和评价也使用固定的图像分辨率。
支持多项决议和更高分辨率的产出将扩大该方法的适用性,同时在保存各种观点的细微视觉细节方面带来更多的挑战。
更大的模式和更加多样化的培训数据将有助于进一步调查三维语言监督的效益规模。
虽然与领先的3D语言理解模型相比,性能差距仍然存在,但未来具有较强理解能力的统一的骨干可能会有助于缩小这一差距,并为新视觉生成提供更丰富的监督.
